rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone is generally cautious and alert to possible danger.

example.english: When I walk home after a night shift, I’m wary and keep an eye out for anyone suspicious.

rows.note: Use this when the wariness is directed at a specific person, animal, danger, or trick.

example.english: People have been pretending to be delivery workers to scam money lately, so you should be wary of them.

rows.note: Use this when the person is specifically suspicious or guarded toward A rather than merely careful.

example.english: I’m wary of this salesperson, so I don’t dare let him into the house.
example.traditional: 我對呢個推銷員有戒心，唔敢畀佢入屋。
